## You're eligible for Kaiju Damage Compensation — with extra support

**Eligibility outcome: Eligible ✅**
Your Tanaka Bakery incident qualifies because it involves verified structural damage to a property in Zone 4, which meets the base rule:
> *"Claims require verified structural damage to a property in zones 3, 4 or 5."* — [/claims/eligibility/](#zone)

You're also well within the 90-day claim filing window (21 days since the incident) and the 72-hour incident report deadline should already be satisfied.

### Extra support you qualify for

1. **Assessment fee waiver** — The standard ¥12,000 claim assessment fee is waived for you.
   > *"Claimants with two or more approved claims from separate incidents within any rolling 12-month period are exempt from the ¥12,000 assessment fee."* — [/claims/faq/](#fee-waivers)

2. **Hardship supplement** — Your household income (¥3,600,000) is under the ¥4,000,000 threshold.
   > *"Households with annual income below ¥4,000,000 receive a hardship supplement."* — [/claims/eligibility/](#hardship)

3. **Business interruption coverage** — Since Tanaka Bakery is a commercial property.
   > *"Compensation covers business interruption for commercial properties."* — [/claims/damage-compensation/](#covered)

### Documents you need to bring

Because of your specific situation (structural damage, hardship supplement, and business-interruption eligibility), you'll need:

| Document | Notes |
|---|---|
| **Incident report receipt** | Must have been filed within 72 hours of the incident |
| **Damage survey** | Photographs + itemised loss schedule (shopfront and rear wall) |
| **Proof of ownership or tenancy** | For Tanaka Bakery |
| **Household income certificate** | Required specifically because you're claiming the hardship supplement |
| **Business registration certificate** | Required for your business-interruption claim |

*(You do **not** need an insurance settlement letter since no insurer has paid out.)*

### Practical notes
- **Processing time:** ~15 business days until an assessor visits, and up to 45 days total to a determination.
- **Fee:** Normally ¥12,000, but waived in your case due to repeat-claimant status; note that even without the waiver it would be refunded in full for awards above ¥1,000,000.

All details sourced from: [/claims/eligibility/](/claims/eligibility/), [/claims/faq/](/claims/faq/), [/claims/damage-compensation/](/claims/damage-compensation/), and [/claims/how-to-file/](/claims/how-to-file/).
